title: Circuit breaker threshold: 3 reassignments in 10 minutes triggers block
body: The dispatcher circuit breaker fires when a task accumulates 3+ reassignments within a 10-minute window. The task status is set to 'blocked', the event is logged in task_events with event_type='circuit_breaker', and the task requires manual intervention to resume.
source_ref: facts.db:task_events WHERE event_type='circuit_breaker' meta field; flotilla_arxiv_spec.md
